title: Exact constructible extension by zero in the native Weil sheaf category
statement: Fix a finite field $k_0$ and a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$. Use the locally finite continuous $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ coefficient sheaves, the categories $\mathcal A_T$ of their module sheaves, the categories $\mathcal W_T$ of pro-etale sheaves with invertible Frobenius structure, and the constructibility condition of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Let $j:U\hookrightarrow T$ be a quasi-compact open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] of $k_0$-schemes locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Equip extension by zero along $\bar j$ with the Frobenius comparison specified in the framework. This functor $j_{0!}:\mathcal W_U\to\mathcal W_T$ is additive and preserves finite limits and finite colimits. For every $F\in\mathcal W_U$ whose underlying sheaf is constructible, the underlying sheaf of $j_{0!}F$ is constructible.

Apply those instances to j. This uses precisely the native framework functor, including its actual Frobenius comparison.

proof.text: For each native Weil sheaf F and its constructibility hypothesis hF, apply the existing theorem WeilSheaf.isAdicConstructibleSheaf_extensionByZero j F hF. Its source proof uses affine open neighbourhoods, the qcqs open intersection, finite lisse stratification, and the closed zero complement. The quasi-compactness and over-base hypotheses are exactly those of the present theorem. Package this with the three instances by conjunction introduction. No statement or definition is changed.
